checks.text: The page heading reads "Text Readability Score".
Typing "The cat sat on the mat." into the code editor (the area labelled "Input text") shows "Words: 6", "Sentences: 1", "Paragraphs: 1", and "Characters: 24" in the stats panel.
With the text "The cat sat on the mat." in the editor, the score labelled "Flesch Reading Ease" shows "90.0" and the score labelled "Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level" shows "0.0".
Replacing the editor content with "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. It was a very good day." shows "Words: 16", "Sentences: 2", and the score labelled "Flesch Reading Ease" shows "80.5".
Clicking the checkbox labelled "Gunning Fog" makes the score labelled "Gunning Fog" appear in the results panel; unchecking it removes that row.
Clicking the button labelled "Copy report" shows a toast with the text "Report copied to clipboard" and the clipboard contains a line starting with "Text Readability Report".
Clicking the button labelled "Download .txt" triggers a file download named "readability-report.txt" whose first line is "Text Readability Report".

Switching to the tab labelled "History" after running an analysis shows a table row containing "The cat sat on the mat." and "90.0"; clicking the button labelled "Clear history" removes all rows and shows "No analyses yet".
Reload keeps the editor text "The cat sat on the mat." and the checked state of the checkbox labelled "Gunning Fog".
